mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months indicates an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand recovery, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 index points signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 90.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year indicates accelerating inflation, which increases the likelihood of future monetary tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% yoy (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real GDP (GDPC1) following a contraction, combined with rising residential investment (HOUST), indicates a recovery in aggregate demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 growth > 0.5% qoq and HOUST > 580.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 9.5 and PAYEMS > 130000.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction term Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90, combined with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a supply-side shock with weak demand, which triggers risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: supply shock with labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 90.0 and UNRATE > 9.6 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction term Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
